title: Post-Shearing 1x SMRTbell Bead Cleanup (Manual Version)
author: Jae Hee Jang
materials: Recommended: Evaluate sample quality (concentration and size distribution)

steps.title: Equilibrate beads to room temperature
steps.instruction: Allow SMRTbell cleanup beads to sit at room temperature for at least 00:20:00 before use.

steps.title: Vortex beads to resuspend
steps.instruction: Vortex the SMRTbell cleanup beads thoroughly to obtain a uniform suspension.

steps.title: Add beads to sheared DNA
steps.instruction: Add 1.0× v/v of the resuspended, room‑temperature SMRTbell cleanup beads to each tube containing sheared DNA.

steps.title: Mix beads and DNA
steps.instruction: Pipette‑mix using wide‑bore pipette tips until the beads are evenly distributed, or gently flick the tubes to mix.

steps.title: Collect liquid by quick spin
steps.instruction: Quick‑spin the tube strip in a microcentrifuge to collect all liquid at the bottom of the tubes.

steps.title: Incubate for DNA binding
steps.instruction: Leave the tubes at room temperature for 00:10:00 to allow DNA to bind to the beads.

steps.title: Separate beads magnetically
steps.instruction: Place the tube strip in a magnetic separation rack until the beads have fully separated from the solution.

steps.title: Remove supernatant
steps.instruction: Slowly pipette off the cleared supernatant without disturbing the beads and discard it.

steps.title: First 80% ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL (or enough to cover the beads) of freshly prepared 80 % ethanol to each tube, wait 00:00:30, then pipette off the ethanol and discard.

substeps.instruction: Dispense 200 µL (or sufficient volume) of fresh 80 % ethanol into each tube.
Remove and discard the ethanol without disturbing the beads.

steps.title: Second 80% ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Repeat the ethanol wash: add 200 µL (or enough to cover the beads) of fresh 80 % ethanol, wait 00:00:30, then remove and discard the ethanol.

substeps.instruction: Dispense 200 µL (or sufficient volume) of fresh 80 % ethanol into each tube.
Remove and discard the ethanol without disturbing the beads.

steps.title: Remove residual ethanol
steps.instruction: Eliminate remaining ethanol by removing the strip from the magnet, quick‑spinning, re‑placing on the magnet, and pipetting off any residual ethanol.

substeps.instruction: Remove the tube strip from the magnetic rack.
Quick‑spin the strip in a microcentrifuge.
Place the strip back in the magnetic rack until beads re‑separate.
Pipette off and discard any residual ethanol.

steps.title: Add low TE and resuspend
steps.instruction: Immediately add 48.5 µL of low‑TE buffer to each tube, then resuspend the beads by pipetting 10 times (or until evenly distributed) using wide‑bore tips; alternatively, gently flick the tubes.

steps.title: Collect liquid by quick spin
steps.instruction: Quick‑spin the tube strip in a microcentrifuge to collect the eluate at the bottom of the tubes.

steps.title: Elute DNA at room temperature
steps.instruction: Leave the tubes at room temperature for 00:05:00 to elute DNA from the beads.

steps.title: Separate beads magnetically
steps.instruction: Place the tube strip back in the magnetic separation rack until the beads have fully separated from the solution.

steps.title: Transfer eluate to new tubes
steps.instruction: Slowly pipette off 47 µL of cleared supernatant without disturbing the beads, transfer it to a new tube strip, and discard the original strip containing the beads.

steps.title: Prepare 1:10 dilution
steps.instruction: Take 1 µL of each eluate and dilute with 9 µL of elution buffer or water to create a 1:10 dilution.

steps.title: Measure DNA concentration (Qubit)
steps.instruction: Measure the DNA concentration of the 1:10 dilution using the Qubit 1× dsDNA High Sensitivity kit.

steps.title: Measure DNA size distribution (Femto Pulse)
steps.instruction: Assess the DNA size distribution of the 1:10 dilution using the Agilent 165 kb Genomic DNA kit on a Femto Pulse instrument.
